item.title: Creative Strategist
item.description: Creative Strategist Organization: Rocket Money Location: Detroit, MI | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Washington, DC Date Posted: 09/03/2026 ## ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮 Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey. ## ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️ Reporting to the Head of Creative, you will help lead the creative experimentation roadmap to drive performance across Rocket Money’s digital acquisition channels. You’ll own the execution and analysis of creative testing across paid channels. As a key player on the growth team, you’ll help shape strategy, uncover creative insights, and push the boundaries of creative performance. This is a high-impact role in a fast-scaling environment, perfect for someone eager to accelerate growth through data-driven creative innovation. Specifically, you will: – Help the development and execution of Rocket Money’s creative testing roadmap, driving scale and efficiency across both digital and offline channels. – Collaborate closely with the creative team to design, implement, and optimize creative experiments. You will recommend testing approaches, monitor performance, analyze results, and translate insights into clear creative direction that continuously elevates the team’s output. – Conduct in-depth creative performance analyses, translating data into clear, actionable recommendations for the creative team to enhance future campaigns. – Establish yourself as an expert in creative experimentation within the app and web user acquisition space. You will stay up to date on industry trends and emerging opportunities, ensuring we lead the charge in creative innovation. Your ability to understand and leverage data sources will be essential in evaluating and refining creative test outcomes. – Stay ahead of industry trends by researching the latest algorithmic insights, creative trends (paid and organic), and forging strong partnerships with channel representatives (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other key platforms) to identify and capitalize on creative testing opportunities that drive scale and growth. – Cultivate a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team by regularly sharing data-driven trends and the outcomes of creative experiments. ## ABOUT YOU 🦄 – 2–4 years of experience in user acquisition or data-driven marketing at a high-growth startup/company or media agency. – Excellent project management skills, balancing multiple creative projects and experiments. – Ability to manage a testing roadmap, prioritize experiments, and work cross-functionally with creative, media buying, and data teams to drive growth through discovering creative wins. – Analytical with a focus on key growth KPIs (ROAS, CAC, LTV:CAC, etc.) and the ability to translate data into actionable creative strategies. – Expertise in mobile app user acquisition; web acquisition experience is a plus. – Familiar with creative testing platforms and optimization across paid social channels. – A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo and uses data or experiments to uncover insights. – Strong communicator and collaborator, aligning teams on testing strategies and optimization plans. ## WE OFFER 💫 – Health, Dental & Vision Plans – Competitive Pay – 401k Matching – Unlimited PTO – Lunch daily (in-office only) – Snacks & Coffee (in-office only) – Commuter benefits (in-office only) Salary range: $95,000 – $125,000/year + bonus + benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This job description is an outline of the primary responsibilities of this position and may be modified at the discretion of the company at any time. Decisions related to employment are not based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. The company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. The information regarding compensation and other benefits included in this paragraph is the company’s current, good faith estimate at the time of posting. Compensation and benefits are subject to modification from time to time as the Company, in its sole and exclusive discretion, deems appropriate. The Company may determine during its future reviews of the proposed compensation and benefits provided for this position that the compensation and benefits for such position should be reduced. In no event will the Company reduce the compensation for the position to a level below the applicable jurisdictional minimum wage rate for the position. Los Angeles County and San Francisco Candidates only: qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment per the Fair Chance Ordinance and the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring. item.title: Lead, External Affairs
item.description: Lead, External Affairs Organization: DPR Construction Location: Washington, DC | Austin, TX | Denver CO | San Fransico Bay Area, CA Date Posted: 09/03/2026 # Lead, External Affairs DPR Construction DPR Construction has partnered with the recruiting firm Big Fish on this search. Please contact Chaz Cirame at [email protected] for more information on how to apply, or with any questions or referrals regarding the role. # Lead, External Affairs **Organization:** DPR Construction **Title:** Lead, External Affairs ## About the Organization DPR Construction is a national commercial general contractor and construction management firm specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects across advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education, and corporate office markets. Founded in 1990 by Doug Woods, Peter Nosler, and Ron Davidowski (the “D,” “P,” and “R”), the company was built on the purpose *“We Exist to Build Great Things.”* Today DPR employs roughly 11,000 people nationwide and internationally, with 2024 revenue of $10.8 billion, and is working toward a 2030 mission to become the most admired company in its industry. ## Position Summary The Lead, External Affairs plays a critical role in advancing DPR’s business objectives by identifying, monitoring, assessing, and managing external issues that could impact the company’s reputation, operations, workforce, clients, and long-term growth. This position serves as a key connector between DPR and external stakeholders, including industry associations, coalitions, policymakers, business organizations, and other influential partners. This role leads proactive issue tracking and management efforts, develops engagement strategies around emerging business and policy issues, and helps position DPR as a trusted industry leader — working cross-functionally with Communications, Operations, Legal, Social Responsibility, and subject-matter experts to ensure DPR is prepared to navigate a dynamic external landscape while advancing opportunities aligned with the company’s mission and goals. ## Essential Skills – 7+ years of experience in external affairs, corporate affairs, public affairs, government relations, public policy, stakeholder engagement, or a related discipline. – Demonstrated experience analyzing and managing complex issues with business and reputational implications. – Familiarity with issue management, reputation management, and stakeholder engagement best practices. – Knowledge of legislative, regulatory, and public affairs processes. – Experience working with industry associations, coalitions, business organizations, or advocacy groups. – Strong strategic planning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. – Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. – Proven ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across diverse audiences. – Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. – Experience in construction, mission-critical technology, engineering, real estate, infrastructure, or sustainability preferred. ## Primary Responsibilities – Lead DPR’s external issues management process by identifying, monitoring, and assessing emerging risks and opportunities, tracking legislative, regulatory, political, economic, labor, environmental, technology, and industry trends. – Develop issue assessments, executive briefings, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations for leadership. – Facilitate cross-functional issue response planning and support crisis preparedness in coordination with Communications. – Maintain a comprehensive issues tracker and reporting process for leadership visibility. – Serve as DPR’s primary representative within selected industry associations, coalitions, and business organizations, building relationships with coalition leaders, policy influencers, and external stakeholders. – Track coalition priorities and represent DPR in external forums, briefing internal leaders on relevant developments. – Partner with Communications and Social Responsibility to develop messaging, talking points, issue briefs, and thought leadership opportunities, including speaking engagements and partnerships. – Conduct research, benchmarking, and analysis of policy, industry, competitive, and stakeholder trends, translating developments into actionable business insights for executives and regional leaders. – Facilitate internal working groups on priority issues and guide leaders preparing for external meetings or stakeholder conversations. ## Compensation & Benefits This is a full-time position offering a base salary commensurate with experience. Benefits include: **For Your Life** — Medical, Dental, Vision, Wellness **For The Unknown** — Life, Disability, Critical Illness, Legal **For Balance** — Holidays, Time Off, Counseling **For Your Family** — Family Formation, Flex Spending, Pet, Auto and Home **For Your Next Great Thing** — 401(K), Profit Sharing, Education, College Savings Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and the position will remain open until filled. **Salary Range:** $150,000 – $260,000 Earn a certificate with the Council! item.title: Director of Brand Strategy
item.description: Director of Brand Strategy Organization: Workiva Location: Remote Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## Director of Brand Strategy Workiva is looking for a Director of Brand Strategy to serve as a key architect of our brand’s growth and long‑term evolution. You will bridge the gap between high‑level market intelligence and world‑class execution, with responsibility for Workiva’s global brand strategy, brand narrative, campaigns, media, and measurement. You will lead a team, manage agency relationships, and shape how Workiva is understood by the CFO, CIO, and other C‑suite buyers who ultimately choose us. This is a rare opportunity to define a category in a rapidly evolving enterprise and AI‑driven landscape. ## About the Brand Marketing Team The Global Brand Marketing team is Workiva’s centralised in‑house brand and creative function, sitting within Marketing and responsible for brand expression across the company. We care about strategy, storytelling, craft, consistency, and doing world‑class work that reflects the quality of what Workiva builds. The team partners with functions across the business to ensure Workiva shows up with intention at every touchpoint, internally and externally. Join a forward‑thinking team where 100% of marketing employees set annual AI goals and complete comprehensive AI training. As we transition to a fully AI‑embedded organization, Workiva is investing in its marketers to be best‑in‑class AI practitioners. — ## What You’ll Do ### Brand strategy and positioning Define and evolve Workiva’s brand positioning and corporate narrative: category framing, platform story, and sharp differentiation into a cohesive messaging system that travels across every touchpoint. Translate company strategy into clear, compelling market positioning. Build a strategy for growing Workiva’s awareness and share of voice in our category, so that when buyers think of financial reporting, GRC, or sustainability, they think of Workiva first. ### Brand architecture, naming, and portfolio Define Workiva’s brand architecture and naming strategy. Partner with Product Marketing to develop and govern a clear, consistent naming and nomenclature system across products and experiences that scales as the portfolio grows and reinforces the master brand. ### Campaign strategy and management Provide executive oversight and strategic direction for the brand campaign function, ensuring alignment with broad company objectives. Establish the vision, priorities, and operational standards for integrated marketing initiatives. ### Brand measurement and insights Build and own Workiva’s brand measurement architecture, including brand health tracking, campaign effectiveness measurement, and the internal Brand Index. Connect brand metrics to real business outcomes: awareness, perception, pipeline, and retention. Turn raw data and research into sharp, actionable insights that give leadership a clear pulse on how customers, prospects, and the market perceive us. Deliver executive‑ready reporting that makes brand investment quantifiable and defensible. ### Brand management and governance Own Workiva’s brand standards, guidelines, and governance framework. Drive consistent brand expression across marketing, product, people and culture, and sales. Build scalable tools and enablement programs that make it easy for every team — globally and in every language — to show up as one brand. ### AI‑Forward Brand Systems Leverage AI tools to develop brand strategies and scalable frameworks designed for speed, efficiency, and impact. Future‑proof how Workiva’s brand operates in a fast‑moving marketing landscape. ### Team leadership Lead and develop a team of brand and marketing professionals. Set direction, build capability, and create a high‑performance culture that balances strategic rigor with executional excellence. — ## What You’ll Need ### Minimum Qualifications – 10+ years in brand strategy, integrated marketing strategy, or enterprise campaign strategy, in‑house or at agency – Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field ### Preferred Qualifications – Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams – Proven experience in B2B SaaS or platform companies at enterprise scale – Track record defining brand narratives, positioning, and messaging systems – Experience owning brand measurement frameworks and connecting brand metrics to business outcomes – Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions – Experience building or evolving a category‑defining brand platform – Experience managing agency relationships across creative, research, and media – Ability to dive into market data and research and identify which insights actually matter — and translate them into a clear, compelling narrative for designers, writers, and executives alike – Experience governing naming and brand architecture at scale across a growing product portfolio – Familiarity with brand governance at global scale across multiple languages and regions – Genuine curiosity about or hands‑on experience with AI’s role in modern brand and marketing systems — ## Travel Requirements & Working Conditions **Location:** Flexible/Remote **Travel:** Up to 25% for team, partner, and stakeholder collaboration **Remote:** Must maintain reliable internet access when working outside a Workiva office — ## How You’ll Be Rewarded – Salary range in the US: $154,000.00 – $250,000.00 – A discretionary bonus typically paid annually – Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire – 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. — ## Why Join Workiva Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI‑powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic. Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email [email protected] . Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards. Workiva supports employees in working where they work best — either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment. #LI‑HS2 Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! item.title: Vice President of PR & Corporate Communications
item.description: Vice President of PR & Corporate Communications Organization: Workiva Location: Remote Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## **Workiva VP of PR & Corporate Communications** Workiva is looking for a strategic, high‑impact, and business‑minded communications leader to shape and scale how we tell the Workiva story to the audiences that matter most. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Vice President of PR & Corporate Communications will lead Workiva’s global communications function across external communications, public relations, product and crisis communications, public affairs, and executive communications. This leader will be responsible for building a modern communications engine that strengthens Workiva’s reputation, elevates executive visibility, and advances our position as a trusted global technology company. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in B2B SaaS, global communications, and high‑growth public company environments, with a proven ability to translate complex business, technology, regulatory, and market themes into clear narratives that inspire action and build trust. This is a highly cross‑functional role that will partner closely with Marketing, Brand, People & Culture, Legal, Investor Relations, Product, Sales, Customer Experience, and the executive leadership team. The VP will lead a team of communications professionals and manage external agency partners to deliver proactive, integrated, and measurable communications programs. — ## **What You’ll Do** ### **Lead Workiva’s Global Communications Strategy** **Integrated Narrative Strategy:** Develop and execute an integrated global strategy that translates company strategy, AI innovation, product value, regulatory trends, and customer momentum into compelling narratives. **Executive & Internal Comms:** Serve as trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team. Build authentic executive thought‑leadership platforms, handle media prep, speechwriting, and executive social strategy. Partner with Internal Comms (People & Culture) so employees hear major news first. **Operating Rhythms & Governance:** Establish communications priorities, agency governance models, and measurable KPIs that align external storytelling with business outcomes. — ### **Own External Communications, Public Relations, and Reputation** **PR & Media Management:** Lead external communications, corporate announcements, media relations, awards, and thought leadership. Oversee press releases, briefing materials, and Q&A assets. **Spokesperson & Brand Positioning:** Serve as a senior company spokesperson when appropriate. Partner with Brand, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, and CPX to amplify platform value and customer impact. **Crisis Communications & Issues Readiness:** Own crisis strategy in partnership with Legal, Security, People & Culture, IR, and CPX. Build playbooks, escalation paths, and scenario plans to provide calm, clear counsel during high‑pressure events. — ### **Build Global Thought Leadership and Stakeholder Communications** **Drive Global Thought Leadership & Reputation:** Lead public affairs and strategic communications strategies to build Workiva’s global reputation, connecting the brand to high‑impact global forums (e.g., Davos, UN) and core topics like trust, sustainability, and responsible innovation. **Elevate Executive & Stakeholder Engagement:** Define and execute high‑visibility positioning for C‑suite leaders—specifically the CEO and CFO—identifying strategic convenings, partnerships, and platform opportunities to expand external influence. **Align Partnerships & Cross‑Functional Messaging:** Partner across the organization to integrate public and private partnerships into Workiva’s corporate narrative, ensuring cohesive messaging and brand alignment without direct lobbying responsibilities. — ### **Lead Executive Communications and Executive Social** **Advise Executive Leadership:** Serve as trusted communications advisor to the CEO and leadership team to build differentiated thought‑leadership platforms. **Develop C‑Suite Content:** Write executive speeches, keynotes, social content, and event narratives tied to major company announcements, financial milestones, and earnings moments. **Prep Leaders for Key Moments:** Brief and media‑train executives for press interviews, industry events, customer keynotes, and Board communications. — ### **Lead Crisis Communications and Issues Readiness** **Lead Crisis Strategy & Counsel:** Drive Workiva’s global crisis response strategy, providing calm, timely guidance to C‑suite leaders during high‑pressure situations. **Build Preparedness Infrastructure:** Develop and maintain crisis playbooks, escalation paths, scenario plans, and messaging frameworks to ensure rapid response. **Coordinate Cross‑Functional Alignment:** Partner with Legal, Security, People, IR, and external agencies to deliver coordinated, legally sound, and values‑aligned communications. — ### **Build and Lead a High‑Performing Team** **Lead & Develop the Team:** Direct a team of 3–5 communications professionals plus external agencies, fostering a high‑performance, inclusive, and accountable culture. **Optimize Team Operations:** Define clear goals, priorities, and an operating model that balances proactive storytelling, executive support, and daily execution. **Manage Agency Performance:** Oversee global agency relationships and contractors to maximize strategic ROI, execution quality, and measurable outcomes. — ## **What You’ll Need** ### **Minimum Qualifications** – 15+ years of progressive communications experience, including senior leadership experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or a similarly complex global business – Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience ### **Preferred Qualifications** – Proven track record leading enterprise communications in a $1B+ revenue public or late‑stage global B2B SaaS company – Exceptional business acumen and gravitas, with a history of serving as a peer advisor to CEOs, CFOs, and Board members – Strong grasp of B2B SaaS growth drivers, enterprise sales motions, investor expectations, and public market requirements – Cultivated, senior‑level relationships across top‑tier business, financial, and tech media, with a proven ability to shape high‑level coverage – Demonstrated experience building public affairs programs and positioning leaders at premier global convenings – Proven command in navigating complex corporate crises, regulatory shifts, or sensitive reputational issues with calm, authoritative judgment – Experience establishing communications KPIs that tie public relations, public affairs, and executive positioning directly to corporate strategy and ROI — ## **Travel Requirements & Working Conditions** – Travel is expected up to 25% for executive meetings, company moments, media opportunities, industry events, team connection, and strategic stakeholder engagements – Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office — ## **How You’ll Be Rewarded** – Salary range in the US: $266,000.00 – $345,700.00 – A discretionary bonus typically paid annually – Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire – 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. — ## **Why Join Workiva** Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI‑powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. item.title: Sr Public Relations Manager
item.description: Sr Public Relations Manager Organization: Network Solutions Location: Remote Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## Who we are Network Solutions, a global leader helping small businesses succeed online with websites, domains, hosting and more, is looking for a creative, hands-on Senior PR Manager to turn our multi-channel content engine into meaningful earned media coverage, and to make sure that coverage lives well beyond the press hit. This is a role for a proactive PR professional, someone who has independently run PR programs end-to-end, knows how to spot a story before others see it, and has the media relationships and instinct to turn insights into headlines. You’ll also be the connective tissue between PR and social storytelling, making sure our biggest data studies, press wins, and executive moments get a second life on social. Your work begins with curiosity. You will dig into blogs, survey data, customer stories, product roadmaps, SEO insights, and conversations with in-house experts to uncover story ideas worth sharing. Then, as a story strategist, you will transform those insights into narratives that align with our brand priorities and resonate with the media. You will collaborate closely with the Content, Customer Insights, SEO, Video and Social teams to shape data-driven narratives and craft story angles that extend across channels, powered by strong editorial instincts and the best of AI. Finally, you will partner with our PR firm to collaboratively and individually pitch those stories to top-tier, trade, tech, and SMB outlets, and partner with Social to carry them forward. You will play a key role in connecting PR strategy to our broader storytelling across blog, social, video, and executive visibility. This is not a reactive press release role; it is a strategic, high-impact seat at the content table. You won’t just mine stories, pitch drafts or write press releases — you will connect teams, elevate ideas, and help shape how the world sees a global brand in motion. — ## What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark **Spot the story before it’s assigned.** Monitor content calendars, product roadmaps, survey insights, and customer trends to proactively surface timely media angles and earned coverage opportunities. **Shape and execute strategic media campaigns.** Drive a steady flow of high-impact, customized pitches supported by press releases, quotes, bylines, and reporter prep materials, all crafted by you to align with brand messaging and business goals. **Lead data-driven storytelling, start to finish.** Partner closely with our Content lead and our data-journalism research partner to shape study topics from the headline down, review research drafts for newsworthiness, and work with our PR agency partner on pitching — ensuring every study is built for amplification across PR, blog, social and video. **Be the bridge between PR and Social.** Serve as the direct link to the Social team, making sure published research, data studies, and press wins are translated into engaging, platform-native social content — and champion executive leaders in authoring long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key studies and results. **Amplify executive thought leadership.** Identify and secure opportunities for leaders to contribute commentary, interviews, podcasts, bylines, and timely expert perspectives (often helping to draft these) in top-tier media and on their own social channels. **Cultivate strong press relationships.** Deepen visibility across tech, SMB, trade, and data-driven business press through consistent, tailored outreach via email, social and calls. **Use AI tools to work smarter.** Leverage AI to brainstorm, outline, personalize and accelerate story development, while contributing to our evolving approach to AI-enabled communications. **Track what matters.** Monitor earned media coverage, share of voice, sentiment, and survey impact to continually refine pitch strategy and messaging. — ## Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed You’re a PR pro with a journalist’s instinct for storytelling and a marketer’s eye for relevance. You don’t wait to be assigned work; you listen, observe, and connect the dots. You bring sharp editorial judgment and recognize newsworthiness instinctively. When you hear something promising in a meeting, roadmap review, or insights discussion, you immediately see the angle — and you know it doesn’t stop at the press hit; you see how it plays on social, too. You view earned media as a strategic lever, not an output, and know how to extract compelling narratives from raw inputs. You excel at turning insights into headlines, building lasting media relationships, asking smart questions, and translating complex topics into storylines across channels, including social. Whether your background is agency, in-house or a mix of both, you thrive in fast-moving, content-rich environments. You’re curious, adaptable, and energized by how AI and new tools can elevate storytelling. You’ve built strong relationships with key journalists and consistently secure meaningful coverage that advances our brand narrative. Insights (i.e., data, trends, customer stories) regularly become compelling, timely, multi-channel narratives that show up across PR, blog, social and video. Data studies and press wins consistently get a second life on social, and executive leaders are publishing long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key research and results. You’re viewed as an initiative-taking, strategic partner who brings earned media thinking into product conversations, content planning, and brand storytelling. You’ve established a predictable PR rhythm through a thoughtful media calendar, consistent outreach, and a steady flow of timely ideas. You’ve helped sharpen how the brand shows up externally, contributing to a cohesive, insight-driven story in the market across earned media and social alike. — ## Requirements 6–10+ years in PR, with B2B tech/SaaS experience Existing relationships with top-tier and tech journalists Strong news sense and ability to translate insights into stories Direct pitching experience and comfort driving outbound media Exceptional writing skills across formats: press releases, tailored pitches, bylines, spokesperson quotes, talking points Fluency in social storytelling — able to spot how a press hit, data study, or executive moment should show up on social (especially LinkedIn) and comfortable partnering closely with a Social team to bring it to life Skilled at managing cross-functional relationships Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research and content development Experience managing or partnering with PR agencies — ## Nice-to-Haves Based in the Eastern time zone Mixed background (agency + in-house) Experience with data storytelling or insights-driven narratives, ideally including survey- or research-based campaigns Experience partnering with a data-journalism or research agency on earned media campaigns Familiarity with domains, hosting, website builders, or digital presence platforms Experience in PR during a rebrand or brand transformation — ## Travel Limited travel (approx. 1–3 trips per year for planning meetings, events, or media engagements) — ## Why you’ll love us We are in a major rebrand, and you’ll help shape how the world sees a legacy brand on the rise across press, social and LLMs. Huge storytelling runway: millions of customers, a data-rich environment, and content engines across blog, survey, SEO, video, social and product. A chance to influence visibility of a global brand across multiple channels. A positive, high-growth environment where autonomy is paired with close leadership access and collaboration. A cross-functional ecosystem that’s collaborative, energetic and committed to elevating our stories. Opportunities to experiment with AI, data, and next-generation PR methodologies. We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. **Work-life balance.** Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. **We celebrate one another’s differences.** We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally. **We care about you.** We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Life/AD&D/STD/LTD, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more! **Where can we take you?** We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold! #NetworkSolutions #LI-VM1 #LI-Remote Employment with Newfold Digital is at-will and nothing in this Job Description should be interpreted or construed to alter the at-will employment relationship. This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above. item.title: Media Relations Senior Specialist
item.description: Media Relations Senior Specialist Organization: Nixon Peabody LLP Location: Albany, NY | Boston, MA | Manchester, NH | New York City, NY | Providence, RI | Rochester, NY | Washington, DC Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## **Job Overview** **Job ID:** 4720 **Position:** Specialist **Location:** Multiple Offices **Job Function:** Professional Staff ## **Job Description** The Media Relations Senior Specialist is responsible for developing and executing integrated public relations strategies that elevate the firm’s reputation, promote our attorneys’ notable work, and advance thought leadership across litigation, transactional work, pro bono, and firmwide initiatives. A hybrid work schedule is available for this position. In this highly visible position, the Media Relations Senior Specialist plays a key role on the team by building relationships across Marketing, Communications, Business Development, and with the firm’s attorneys, to identify, pitch, and secure coverage of story angles that raise Nixon Peabody’s reputation in mainstream, industry-focused, and legal trade publications. The Media Relations Senior Specialist: – Cultivates relationships with journalists; – Manages projects from concept to completion; – Engages with attorneys and builds effective relationships; and – Tracks the impact of media efforts to demonstrate value. This Media Relations Senior Specialist also partners closely with practice groups, industry teams, and marketing colleagues to align media activity with firm strategic priorities. A career at Nixon Peabody is the opportunity to do work that matters. It’s the chance to use your knowledge to shape what’s ahead. To share, to innovate, to learn at a firm that taps the power of collective thinking. We’ve created a dynamic, energizing environment that promotes success for our clients and each other. We offer fast growth, connectedness and training in business as well as law. And our rigorous standards assure you are part of a diverse team of top talent at every turn. If you’re someone who’s looking toward the future, we’d love to hear from you. **Location:** Albany, NY; Boston, MA; Manchester, NH; New York City, NY; Providence, RI; Rochester, NY; Washington, DC — ## **Media Strategy and Proactive Outreach** – Build relationships with attorneys, Communications, and Business Development colleagues to identify newsworthy industry trends, firm-advised deals, litigation milestones, and other story ideas that raise the visibility of the firm and its attorneys – Proactively pitch story ideas, expert commentary, and thought leadership to reporters, editors, and producers at target outlets – Cultivate and maintain direct relationships with journalists at priority mainstream, industry, and legal publications – Analyze editorial calendars from priority publications and identify opportunities for bylined articles, third-party commentary, and expert sourcing – Support the development and execution of integrated PR campaigns tied to firm strategic priorities, practice group initiatives, and industry team efforts — ## **Media Engagement and Inquiries** – Serve as a point of contact for inbound media inquiries, coordinating attorney responses and routing requests appropriately and in a timely manner – Assist team members with developing briefing sheets, talking points, and interview prep materials for attorneys – Support attorney media coaching and interview preparation, including pre-interview walkthroughs when needed – Coordinate media training opportunities for attorneys in partnership with internal team members or external agencies — ## **Content Development and Publication** – Write press releases on a regular basis and publish to the firm’s website – Create internal- and external-facing write-ups for media mentions of the firm and our attorneys, raising visibility of coverage across the firm – Repurpose media coverage into content for LinkedIn, internal newsletters, attorney bios, and other firm channels in coordination with the social media and digital teams – Support storytelling around pro bono, social impact, and well-being initiatives — ## **Media Lists, Monitoring, and Measurement** – Identify key media targets and build and maintain media lists for targeted journalist engagement – Manage daily media monitoring and coverage tracking through related tools (e.g., Meltwater, Cision, and Muck Rack) – Maintain and improve the Media Relations team’s document management system and reporting functions – Prepare regular reports on media coverage, share of voice, and campaign performance for firm leadership, practice groups, and industry teams — ## **Cross-Functional Collaboration** – Partner with practice groups and industry teams to align media activity with their strategic priorities and business development goals – Support event-related media outreach around firm conferences, sponsored programming, and other high-profile activities – Assist with issues management and reactive media matters, including drafting holding statements and helping coordinate internal responses – Coordinate with external PR agencies or vendors as needed — ## **Innovation and Continuous Improvement** – Apply AI and emerging technology tools to enhance media workflows, including drafting support, media list-building, and monitoring – Stay current on trends in legal media, industry publications, and PR best practices, and share insights with the team and appropriate stakeholders – Perform other duties as assigned To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential job responsibility listed above, satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. Nixon Peabody retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the skills and abilities required. — ## **Job Requirements** – 3–5 years of experience in journalism and/or public relations, preferably within a law firm, public relations agency, or a professional services environment – Experience with social media management encouraged – Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field required; experience in lieu of a degree will be considered – Proficient writing, editing, and proofreading skills; ability to distill complex details into succinct information for a range of audiences – Strong communication skills, both verbal and written – Ability to build productive relationships with personnel at all levels, including attorneys and key stakeholders – Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously without compromising quality – Demonstrated ability to work under pressure with strict timelines – Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and work productively with a variety of personalities – Technology fluency across tools including AI platforms, media-related tools, and digital collaboration and content management systems — ## **Salary Range** In accordance with applicable Federal and State laws, the anticipated annual salary range for this position, depending on location, is as follows: – Albany, NY: $70,500 to $104,500 – Manchester, NH: $70,500 to $104,500 – Providence, RI: $70,500 to $104,500 – Rochester, NY: $70,500 to $104,500 – Boston, MA: $77,500 to $114,950 – Washington, DC: $77,500 to $114,950 – New York, NY: $85,000 to $126,500 In addition to a standard benefits package, this role may be eligible for additional contingent compensation based on an array of factors, including but not limited to: work performance, geographic location, work experience, education, and qualifications. Because such contingent compensation is not yet calculable or may be zero ($0) in some circumstances, the above-listed salary range(s) are Nixon Peabody’s good faith estimate of the annual salary(ies) it reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of this posting. — ## **Equal Opportunity Statement** Nixon Peabody LLP is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer: Disability / Veteran. Nixon Peabody is committed to creating a fair workplace and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. To comply with Federal law, Nixon Peabody participates in E-Verify. All newly hired employees are verified through this electronic system established by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and the Social Security Administration (SSA) to confirm their identity and employment eligibility. Please refer to the Notice of E-Verify Participation and the Right to Work posters on the Nixon Peabody Careers page for more information. #LI-Hybrid Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! item.title: Director of Public Relations and Communications
item.description: Director of Public Relations and Communications Organization: Visit Seattle Location: Seattle, WA Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## About Visit Seattle Visit Seattle is a private, non-profit destination marketing organization (DMO) serving Seattle and King County. We exist to responsibly grow the visitor economy for the benefit of the community. ## About the Role The Director of Public Relations and Communications leads Visit Seattle’s public relations and communications function across local, regional, and priority domestic markets. This role develops and executes integrated communications strategies that strengthen Visit Seattle’s brand reputation, position Seattle as a premier destination, increase destination awareness, and generate positive media coverage that supports growth in Seattle’s tourism economy. The Director provides leadership and accountability for three core areas: leisure media, business travel media, and corporate communications. Through strategic planning and execution, this role advances visitor perception, Net Promoter Score (NPS), resident sentiment, and membership engagement. As a key communications leader, the Director partners closely with the Chief Engagement Officer and Public Affairs Manager on legislative and advocacy communications, issues management, briefing materials, and media inquiries. ## What You’ll Do ### Department Leadership – Develop and execute integrated public relations and communications strategies that enhance Visit Seattle’s brand reputation and support organizational objectives. – Partner closely with Visit Seattle’s Conventions Team and Seattle Convention Center (SCC) to develop media strategies that support the meetings and conventions market. – Provide strategic oversight of communications planning and content development, including editorial calendars, media materials, executive communications, stakeholder messaging, and publicity initiatives. – Lead proactive and reactive media relations and publicity efforts across consumer, trade, and industry audiences, overseeing media communications, thought leadership content, and press materials to generate positive earned media coverage and support organizational priorities. – Develop, manage, and execute the scope of work and outputs of a contracted external PR agency. – Have accountability for creating and contributing structure and content for the Visit Seattle signature events. – Oversee corporate communications, including newsletters, board presentations, executive communications, and stakeholder-facing content. – Lead crisis communications planning and response efforts to protect Visit Seattle’s reputation and support the tourism community. – Develop and manage the Public Relations and Communications budget, ensuring responsible stewardship of resources and alignment with strategic priorities. – Perform other related duties as required. ### Media, Industry and Community Representation – Build and maintain strong relationships with local, regional, and national media. – Serve as a designated Visit Seattle spokesperson on destination marketing, organizational initiatives, and key industry issues, in coordination with the Chief Engagement Officer and other Executive Team Leaders and Board Members. – Cultivate and maintain productive relationships with destination marketing organizations, tourism industry partners, and public relations professionals throughout the region. – Represent Visit Seattle in industry, community, and media-facing engagements that support organizational priorities and destination visibility. – Travel as needed to support media relations, industry engagement, and organizational priorities. ### Team Leadership & Development – Lead, coach, and inspire the PR and Communications teams. – Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and incentives aligned with organizational priorities. – Attract, develop, engage, and retain top talent critical to Visit Seattle’s success. – Role-model Visit Seattle’s core values: Inclusion, Impact, Commitment, and Excellence. – Foster a positive, high-performance culture focused on service, accountability, innovation, and measurable impact. – Remove barriers to success, streamline processes, and ensure rapid response to client opportunities. – Contribute to a positive, productive, safe, respectful, professional work environment and culture. ## Qualifications – 10+ years of progressive experience in public relations, communications, media relations, or a related field, including responsibility for developing and executing strategic communication initiatives. – 3–5 years of demonstrated people leadership experience with a track record of building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams. – Experience managing external public relations agencies, including coordinating agency deliverables, aligning communications strategy, and ensuring high-quality execution of public relations initiatives. – Experience serving as an organizational spokesperson, leading crisis communications, and managing sensitive issues with professionalism, credibility, and sound judgement. – Strong media relations experience, with the ability to build and maintain relationships across local, regional, and national media. – Exceptional written and verbal communications skills, including experience developing press releases, executive communications, speeches, presentations, and other stakeholder-facing materials. – Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships across leadership, industry partners, community organizations, members, and other key constituents. – Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, lead complex projects, and deliver results with discretion, accountability, and strategic focus. – Knowledge of the Seattle region and tourism industry landscape preferred. – Able to travel 10–20% for media missions and activations. ## What We Offer Visit Seattle offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, along with a positive, purpose-driven workplace culture. Our culture is guided by our values of Inclusion, Impact, Commitment, and Excellence. We are passionate about championing our region as a world-class destination for travel and tourism and promoting the economic power of travel. Our benefits are always evolving, though here’s a peek into your perks: – You’ll have 15 days of Paid Time Off to start, with 12 paid office holidays and 1 Personal Holiday. – You’ll have 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage paid for by Visit Seattle. In addition, Visit Seattle will cover 75% of premium for family coverage. – You’ll receive an organization-paid ORCA card and subsidized parking in the building’s garage (restrictions apply). – You’ll be reimbursed for monthly cell phone expenses. – You’ll receive 401(k) with up to a 5% organization match. – Base salary range: $120,000 – $150,000 with an annual incentive up to 10%. Compensation decisions are based on experience and scope of responsibility. ## Our Commitment to Equity We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and deeply committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We believe that diversity makes us stronger, more innovative, and better equipped to serve our communities. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds and identities. We do not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Visit Seattle strives to create a meaningful interview experience for candidates. If you need accommodation for a disability or for any other reason during the hiring process, please let us know. item.description: Comms Senior Staff, Global Media Relations Organization: Lockheed Martin Location: Bethesda, MD | Grand Prairie, TX | Stratford, CT | Marietta, GA | Owego, NY | Fort Worth, TX Date Posted: 09/04/2026 **Standard Job Description** **Primary Responsibilities** • Develop and support communications strategies for enterprise strategic initiatives and thought leadership plans, including 21st Century Security priorities. • Support enterprise corporate media relations efforts and coordination of priority media relations activities across Business Areas. • Develop communications materials for key executives, including speeches, remarks, op-eds, talking points, briefing materials, etc. • Build and maintain relationships with key journalists and pitch story ideas. • Serve as media spokesperson as necessary. • Support key corporate and public affairs communications processes. • Collaborate effectively with internal business partners, Executive Communications, Investor Relations, Finance, Legal, Government Affairs, Communications, and colleagues across Enterprise Operations and Business Areas to align strategy and ensure desired communications outcomes. • Provide insightful, informed, and strategic communications counsel to executives. • Manage multiple workstreams and projects simultaneously. Must live within close proximity of a major LM facility. Bethesda location preferred. Ability to travel when needed. Develops, plans, and conducts public relations and goodwill programs to improve and support company business objectives with the public, industry, stockholders, and/or employees. Plans, prepares, writes, and disseminates information utilizing print and broadcast media; magazines, speeches, scripts, intranet and Internet website. Submits photographs; assigns and/or approves artwork. May represent the company at press conferences, briefings, and presentations on company issues. May participate in and support advertising campaigns, and/or edit material for organization publications. May supervise work of outside consultants. **Basic Qualifications** • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 10 years of professional experience; or 8 years of professional experience with a related Master’s degree. • Significant communications experience in aerospace/defense, publicly traded companies, government, or B2G public relations or communications agency/consultancy preferred. • Communications experience including media relations, corporate communications, executive communications, thought leadership, and communications strategy and message development. • Ability to travel as required. **Desired Skills** • Significant media relations experience. • Strong communications planning and project management experience. • Strong interpersonal skills and proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across levels, teams, and functions. • Professional communications experience and strong interest in domestic and international political and policy dynamics and their implications for media and messaging strategy. • Experience and interest in financial communications. • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and compellingly. • Motivated self-starter who works effectively under competing priorities and tight deadlines. • Innovative and creative thinker with a strong work ethic, excellent judgement, positive attitude, and excellent prioritization and time management skills. **Pay Information** Full-Time Salary Range: $123400.00 – $229200.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, as well as market (work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4×10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability. Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. For Washington state applicants only: Non-represented full-time employees accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full-time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. item.description: Associate Vice President Organization: Gregory Location: Philadelphia, PA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## **Gregory AVP Role** Gregory — named PR Agency of the Year by PR Daily and recognized on PRWeek’s Best Places to Work list — is looking for an Associate Vice President to join our team. This role is designed for a rising PR leader who is ready to take on more — more ownership, more strategy, more team responsibility. Client roster will consist of mostly financial services clients — knowledge of the industry is not required but a plus. Candidates must be in commuting distance to one of our US offices (Philadelphia, NYC, Boston). We are one of America’s largest and most innovative communications agencies (and a top 10 financial services PR firm) redefining what’s possible through the power of people and AI. Come join us! — ## **Responsibilities** Take ownership of client accounts with independence, setting daily priorities and aligning team activities to meet client expectations and quality standards Direct media strategy at a senior level, taking on high-impact assignments while delegating effectively to team members based on skill Develop, mentor, and manage junior staff; conduct performance reviews and support career growth Write and oversee strategic press releases, blog posts, media queries, and social media content Serve as the senior day-to-day client contact, fielding inquiries and delivering quality service Contribute to new business development, including leading sales discussions Work closely with senior leadership to build your strategic voice and expand your client portfolio Champion firm initiatives — participate in Gregory marketing, lead or contribute to staff training, and share industry insights with the team Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, media monitoring and outreach, content drafting, and client intelligence — and actively develop your fluency with AI as part of the role — ## **Education / Experience / Skills** Undergraduate degree in communications, public relations, journalism, English, or a related field 5–8 years of PR experience, with experience in account leadership Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and PR industry platforms/tools Strong project management and communication skills Proven ability to lead, mentor, and collaborate across a team Client-service orientation with a solutions-driven mindset Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable to shifting priorities Sales ability and a goal-oriented approach Comfort working with AI tools and a genuine interest in how AI can strengthen your work — ## **Compensation & Benefits** Salary commensurate with experience. We offer our employees a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and paid holidays, life insurance and short-term and long-term disability insurance, among other benefits. — ## **Equal Opportunity Statement** Gregory is an equal opportunity employer, and will not engage in or tolerate unlawful discrimination on account of a person’s sex, age, race, color, religion, creed, sexual preference, or orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military status, veteran status, handicap or disability, or any other protected group or status. item.title: Managing Director, Media Relations
item.description: Managing Director, Media Relations Organization: The Rockefeller Foundation Location: New York City, NY | Washington, DC Date Posted: 09/04/2026 **Salary Range:** $230,000.00 To $280,000.00 Annually **Position Overview** The Rockefeller Foundation Communications team advances the Foundation’s mission by strengthening understanding of its priorities, amplifying impact, and engaging key audiences through strategic communications, digital engagement, content development, and stakeholder outreach. The Managing Director, Media Relations leads how The Rockefeller Foundation earns visibility and safeguards its reputation in a rapidly evolving media and information environment. The role sets the Foundation’s media relations and press strategy, shapes its approach to executive visibility and reputational risk, and ensures a clear, credible, and consistent institutional voice across audiences and platforms. Reporting to the SVP, Communications, the Managing Director serves as a senior advisor to Foundation leadership and leads enterprise-wide media initiatives, working across the Foundation to strengthen its engagement with journalists and other key stakeholders in support of its mission and strategic priorities. **Work Schedule:** This role is on a hybrid work schedule and is required to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. The role can be based in either the Washington, DC, or New York City office, with a preference for the New York City office. **Pay Range:** $230,000 – $280,000. This represents the present low and high end of the Foundation’s pay range for this position. Actual pay will vary based on various factors, including but not limited to experience. — ### Principal Duties and Responsibilities – **Media strategy** — Develop and lead the Foundation’s media relations strategy—setting priorities, frameworks, and standards for media engagement, and translating institutional priorities into integrated media approaches—to strengthen visibility, reputation, and stakeholder engagement across evolving news, digital, and emerging media channels. – **Executive advising** — Serve as a strategic advisor to the Foundation’s President and senior executives on media engagement, messaging, and public visibility—including media pitching, message development, and preparation for interviews and high-profile media events. – **Institutional narrative** — Shape and safeguard the Foundation’s institutional narrative, ensuring talking points and messages stay consistent and in sync across Programs, Teams, and Regional Offices. – **Leadership positioning** — Position Foundation leaders and experts as authoritative voices with the media—providing coaching and strategic counsel and building and managing the public profiles of the President and senior leaders through high-impact op-eds, bylined pieces, speaking platforms, and executive profiles that advance institutional priorities. – **Press materials** — Approve Foundation press releases, media statements, and briefing materials, and serve as a Foundation spokesperson when needed. – **Press office operations** — Oversee the day-to-day operations of the press office, ensuring rapid, accurate, and coordinated responses to inbound media inquiries. – **Reputational risk** — Anticipate and manage reputational risk, detecting emerging issues early and leading crisis communications with clarity and speed, including partnering with the General Counsel on adversarial press, litigation-related communications, and sensitive disclosures. – **Journalist relationships** — Cultivate and manage relationships with journalists and media outlets, using coverage insights, analytics, and emerging trends to inform the most strategic pitching and outlet choices. – **Media operations oversight** — Provide strategic oversight of media relations operations, including budget management and agency/vendor relationships for wire services, media monitoring, and select media sponsorship opportunities. – **Governance systems** — Establish effective systems, governance structures, and operating practices that improve the efficiency, accountability, and quality of the Foundation’s media function. – **Cross-foundation coordination** — Partner with senior leaders across the Foundation and coordinate closely with program focal points and Regional Office colleagues to advance major media moments and high-profile events. – **Consultant management** — Manage outside consultants and agencies engaged for media pitching and strategic advice, and coordinate closely with internal teammates—including Digital and Internal Communications—to ensure an integrated, consistent approach across channels. – **Team leadership** — Provide strategic leadership and oversight to the Media Relations team and external consultants—building leadership capability, fostering collaboration, and coaching team members to create an inclusive, high-performing culture aligned with Foundation priorities, values, and performance expectations. — ### Education, Experience, and Skills – **Media relations experience** — Generally expected to have 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in media relations, journalism, public affairs, or related fields, including significant leadership experience—ideally representing an organization with the media, serving as a spokesperson, or working for a top-tier news organization. – **Education requirements** — Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public affairs, or related discipline. Advanced degree preferred. – **Mission-driven experience** — Experience working within philanthropy, public sector, nonprofit, international development, or similar mission-driven organizations. – **Foreign policy knowledge** — Knowledge of and interest in foreign policy or international affairs. – **Enterprise strategy** — Demonstrated success developing and leading enterprise-level media and reputation strategies for complex, mission-driven organizations. – **Reputational risk management** — Proven track record positioning organizations and their senior leadership, managing reputational risk, and leading crisis communications. – **Executive advising** — Experience advising senior executives and developing media approaches that influence internal and external stakeholders. – **Media trends** — Extensive knowledge of media trends and established relationships with top-tier journalists and media outlets. – **Cross-functional leadership** — Proven ability to lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives and drive organizational outcomes through influence and collaboration. – **People leadership** — Strong people leadership experience, including developing talent and managing high-performing teams. – **Communication skills** — Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including public speaking and the ability to represent the Foundation with external partners. — ### Competencies – **Action Oriented** — Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. – **Collaborates** — Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. – **Manages Complexity** — Makes sense of complex, high-volume, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively. – **Nimble Learning** — Learns through experimentation when tackling new problems, using successes and failures as learning fodder. – **Strategic Mindset** — Sees ahead to future possibilities and translates them into breakthrough strategies. – **Develops Talent** — Develops people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals. — ### About The Rockefeller Foundation The Rockefeller Foundation is a pioneering philanthropy built on collaborative partnerships at the frontiers of science, technology, and innovation that enable individuals, families, and communities to flourish. We make big bets to promote the well-being of humanity in food, health, energy, and finance, including through our public charity, RF Catalytic Capital (RFCC). For more information, sign up for our newsletter at [www.rockefellerfoundation.org/subscribe] and follow us on X @RockefellerFdn and LinkedIn @the-rockefeller-foundation. The Rockefeller Foundation offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that includes health insurance programs, tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment, a generous 401K, parental leave, and various forms of paid time off, all to help employees feel energized, cared for, and engaged. As an organization, we focus on six values to advance our culture and continue our success: Transparent, Optimistic, Accountable, Collaborative, Trusted, and Equitable. We expect all employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices. The Rockefeller Foundation is committed to equal employment opportunity and compliance with all federal, state, and local laws concerning employment discrimination, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. The Foundation ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, liability for service in the United States Armed Forces, or any other protected status. The Rockefeller Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Learn more here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Senior Manager – Corporate Affairs
item.description: Senior Manager – Corporate Affairs Organization: Lidl US Location: Arlington, VA Date Posted: 09/04/2026 ## **About the job** ### **Purpose** The Head of Corporate Affairs leads the strategic alignment of the Corporate Affairs division and the core disciplines of Stakeholder Engagement, Corporate Communication, and CSR. Operating as the central voice for the organization, this role safeguards and enhances the reputation of the company by developing and implementing measures to measure and manage the company’s reputation and strengthen the corporate brand as “One Lidl”. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Corporate Communications & Public Relations** Development and implementation of a national 360° communication strategy including political communication and issue management. Responsibility for internal and external communication, including content creation, as well as active and reactive media work taking into account the international and national communication strategy. Oversee the creation of an overarching editorial and content plan for internal and external communication to ensure a consistent narrative around the corporate brand. Synchronize all internal communication activities in cooperation with other departments (e.g., marketing and employer branding) in the sense of a one‑brand strategy. Ensure binding content and consistent internal messages through cross‑departmental and cross‑thematic coordination. Build and manage strategic engagement with relevant internal stakeholders and opinion leaders. Advising and empowering management and specialist departments on strategic communication challenges. Responsibility for ensuring a regular analysis of the company’s reputation and anchoring reputation as a relevant key performance indicator within the company. #### **Stakeholder Engagement & Political Affairs** Responsibility for the development and implementation of strategic and sustainable stakeholder engagement for the effective representation of company interests, particularly in the political arena. Representation of interests in the national political environment and in regulatory processes. Representing the company or supporting management in relevant associations, organizations, and initiatives. #### **Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)** Developing, implementing, and regularly adapting the CSR strategy, measures, and projects in coordination with Corporate Affairs International. Ensuring CSR reporting capability in the country in accordance with the guidelines specified by Lidl International and ensuring compliance with national regulatory CSR reporting obligations. Responsibility for organizing CSR initiatives to raise awareness of social and environmental issues in line with the Lidl guidelines. Responsibility for coordinating the national company’s donation activities in accordance with international guidelines and processes. Advising and empowering management and specialist departments on CSR based on trend analyses and assessments of the market, politics, and society. — ## **About You** Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Affairs, Business, or a related discipline. 5–7 years of progressive experience in corporate communications, public relations, or stakeholder engagement, ideally within the discount grocer or broader retail sector. In‑depth knowledge of proactive and reactive media relations, crisis communication, and corporate reputation management. Established professional network among journalists, political stakeholders, and industry opinion leaders in the US market. Deep understanding of stakeholder engagement, particularly political stakeholder engagement and CSR initiatives. Exceptional written, verbal, and strategic presentation skills, with the proven ability to advise executive management and craft compelling corporate narratives. Occasional willingness to travel to support national events, store openings, or stakeholder meetings. — ## **Physical Requirements** Ability to travel up to ~15% of the time, which may include weekends and evenings, as needed. Most work is performed in a temperature‑controlled office environment. Must be able to sit for prolonged periods of time at a desk or computer terminal. May use keyboards, telephone, and standard office equipment in the course of a normal workday. Stooping, bending, twisting, and reaching may be required in the completion of job duties. Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at times. — ## **Competencies** **Personal Competencies:** Proactively drives the structural and procedural advancement of the department. Confidently adapts to change, upholds rigorous quality standards, and maintains a healthy balance between team workload and overall operational capacity. **Business Competencies:** Derives specific departmental actions directly from macro corporate strategy. Utilizes data‑driven KPIs to make informed choices, solves complex problems from multiple perspectives, and maintains strict cost‑benefit controlling. **Social Competencies:** Communicates with absolute clarity to persuade diverse audiences. Nurtures trusting cross‑departmental relationships and applies diplomacy to resolve conflicts and negotiate balanced solutions. **Leadership Competencies:** Fosters a trust‑based, learning‑oriented department where mistakes are treated as growth opportunities. Actively mentors and develops team leads while delegating tasks thoughtfully using clear, measurable expectations. — ## **Our Values** **Performance:** We thrive together to passionately pursue ambitious goals, constantly develop ourselves, and turn complex organizational challenges into opportunities. **Respect:** We put people at the center of what we do by treating each other fairly, ensuring equal opportunities, and valuing diversity as a key cultural strength. **Trust:** We believe in each other, communicate openly and honestly, remain completely reliable, and treat mistakes as valuable learning opportunities. **Grounded:** We dream big while staying down to earth, remaining approachable, choosing simplicity over complexity, and focusing firmly on meaningful results. **Belonging:** We are stronger together than we are alone, standing up for one another, leveraging our collective strengths, and focusing on sustainable, long‑term relationships. — ## **What You’ll Receive** At Lidl, we know that in order for our people to do their best, they must be at their best. That’s why as a company, we offer one of the most generous benefits packages in the industry. All our Lidl employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Starting pay of $160,000 (with potential to earn $180,000 in the future) Medical & Prescription | Dental | Vision coverage Paid Holiday & Paid Time Off (PTO) to use for sickness or vacation Dedicated training plans to ensure you are set up for success 401K Plan (+ 5% company match) Voluntary Term Life & AD&D Insurance Total Well‑Being Program DailyPay, a voluntary benefit to offer employees access to their pay on their own schedule Lidl US views our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) through a lens of actions that are Good for the Environment, Good for People, and Good for You. #teamlidl Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today.
