item.title: Strategic Communication and Legislative Policy Analyst
item.description: Strategic Communication and Legislative Policy Analyst Organization: Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) Location: Alexandria, VA Date Posted: 10/05/2026 Job Description Overview Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted. The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues. The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges. We have immediate need for a Strategic Communication and Legislative Policy Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Mark Center or Pentagon. Responsibilities The candidate will provide Strategic Communications and Congressional analysis for the Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Industrial and Investment Security (I2S). This position serves as a trusted advisor supporting DASW (I2S) engagement with DoW leaders, Military departments, interagency stakeholders, and Congress. The candidate will assist I2S in developing effective internal and external stakeholder engagement, recommending specific messaging actions that advance program priorities with Congressional, industry, professional associations, and media stakeholders, and contribute to strengthening these relationships by translating technical information into compelling messaging. The candidate will monitor Congressional correspondence (letters from Members of Congress or committees, requests for information, requests for legislative proposal reviews), hearings, markups, and reports related to I2S. Will prepare weekly legislative status updates, synopsis reports, and ad-hoc briefings to explain how proposed legislation and oversight may impact I2S priorities, and maintain a central repository of official statements, responses to Advance Policy Questions (APQ), and Questions for the Record (QFR). Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in public policy, political science, international relations, or a related field 7+ years of demonstrated experience in strategic communications that highlights proficiency in media monitoring to identify prevailing opinions, misconceptions, sentiment, and strategic opportunities; able to optimize communications by creating structured strategic messaging and engagement plans that foster alignment and informed decision-making Demonstrated experience in Congressional budgeting and procurement processes, and knowledge of the HAC/HASC/SAC/SASC, and the annual defense authorizations and appropriations processes Strong research, writing, and synthesis skills, with the ability to turn complex concepts into clear, actionable products Active TS/SCI clearance Able to work fully onsite based on client needs Desired: Experience supporting DoD, a Service headquarters, or a Congressional committee with strategic communication expertise Familiarity with legislative cycles, authorization and appropriations processes, and Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congressional Research Service, and think‑tank reporting Experience with speechwriting for senior executives Familiarity with governmental public affairs policies and processes, specifically, The Defense Office of Prepublication and Security Review (DOPSR) Pay Range Information At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $150,000.00/Yr. – USD $170,000.00/Yr. EEO Statement: SPA is committed to the principles and practices of equal employment opportunity. It is, and will continue to be, the policy of the company to afford equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. We recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability or genetics or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. item.title: Government Affairs and Capital Region Coordinator
item.description: Government Affairs and Capital Region Coordinator Organization: Riverkeeper Location: Albany, NY | Ossining, NY Date Posted: 10/05/2026 ABOUT US Riverkeeper is New York’s premier water quality advocate. Our mission is to protect and restore the Hudson River from source to sea and safeguard drinking water supplies through advocacy rooted in community partnerships, science, and law. With an annual operating budget of $5 million, Riverkeeper is a mid-sized not-for-profit operating in the Hudson Valley. This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic, mission-oriented organization. For more information, visit www.riverkeeper.org. TITLE: Government Affairs Coordinator DEPARTMENT: Advocacy, Policy, and Planning REPORTS TO: Associate Director, Government Affairs SALARY: $50,000-$60,000 SCHEDULE: Full-time; with flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends LOCATION: Albany, NY and Ossining, NY Hybrid position, one day per week at the Ossining office when not in the field is required. From January through June during New York’s Legislative Session, the Coordinator will be in downtown Albany regularly (about 2–3 days per week) and join the team in Ossining 1–2 days per month. Within and outside of Session, the role includes coordinating advocacy and policy work across the mission area as well as a focus on building relationships within the Capital Region & Mohawk Valley. POSITION SUMMARY The Government Affairs and Capital Region Coordinator is a high-impact role for energetic changemakers focused on advancing Riverkeeper’s state and local policy priorities, with a special emphasis on the New York State legislative session and building our footprint across the Capital Region and Mohawk River Valley. Working closely with the Associate Director of Government Affairs, you will serve as part advocate, project manager, and community organizer—amplifying Riverkeeper’s reach across legislative affairs, policy research, communications, and campaign operations. This position puts you on the front lines of advocacy, collaborating directly with Riverkeeper’s team of scientists, legal experts, and campaigners. It is the perfect fit for an organized, ambitious self-starter seeking a high-energy launchpad in environmental advocacy, ideal for candidates eager to get a crash course in effective policy campaigns and become part of the next generation of climate & environmental leaders. ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (This is not an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities, and requirements.) Advocate for clean water and climate resilience policies at the state, local, and occasionally at the federal level. Coordinate the development of Riverkeeper’s annual policy agenda and legislative priorities under the Associate Director’s supervision. Build and maintain effective relationships with legislators, their staff, experts, and partners, scheduling regular meetings with key legislators, lead coalition calls with partners, and prepare for meetings with legislators, government officials, and key stakeholders to advance clean water policy Assist in drafting legislative memos, testimonies, and budget priorities, providing policy recommendations for legislators. Primary responsibility for organizing advocacy events including lobby days, such as Hudson River Advocacy Day, roundtables, and webinars. Organize meetings and events in the greater Capital Region with local organizations and become a leading voice in the community for clean water and the Hudson River Collaborate with external partners and coalitions to amplify advocacy efforts and achieve shared policy goals. Provide administrative support for the Associate Director of Government Affairs, managing schedules, logistics, and materials for meetings and events. Conduct policy research and track legislation to support the team in identifying clean water legislative priorities Shape the narrative and find your voice as a Riverkeeper spokesperson at press conferences and events Support media strategy by drafting initial press releases, action alerts, and social media content in collaboration with the Communications Team Provide day-to-day task coordination and project guidance for Government Affairs interns under the supervision of the Associate Director Thrive in a fast-paced environment that benefits from quick thinking and dynamic problem-solving EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES Research shows that people from under-represented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Please know that no one ever meets 100% of the qualifications. If much of this describes you, we encourage you to apply. College degree or equivalent practical experience in environmental policy, political science, public administration, or a related field. Have 1-2 years of experience in advocacy, grassroots organizing, or government affairs, or demonstrated experience in community building Are proficient in research, with experience in online research tools, databases, and complex policy topics. Have strong writing skills, with excellent attention to detail Strong event management skills, scheduling, room bookings, turnout mobilization, vendor/materials preparation, and on-site coordination Comfortable with public speaking with a desire to strengthen this skill through practice and on-the-ground experience Strong people skills and demonstrated enthusiasm to build and maintain collegial professional relationships. Ability to organize events, presentations, and community meetings. Demonstrate the ability to be a resourceful, self-starter, able to navigate multiple tasks and priorities independently. Are familiar with Google Drive (Sheets, Docs) and other productivity tools. Are enthusiastic about Riverkeeper’s mission for clean water and climate resilience and ready to support the Associate Director of Government Affairs in achieving annual advocacy goals. Must be eligible to register as a lobbyist under New York State and federal law (i.e., not subject to lobbying bans or restrictions) Must be timely and prompt for appointments and meetings PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS Ability to work in an open office environment with stairs (no elevators) May require sitting or standing for extended periods Requires the ability to navigate extensive distances throughout the NYS legislature complex Ability to regularly travel throughout the Capital Region, Mohawk Valley, and occasionally the Hudson Valley & New York City Ability to carry bulky dossiers to meetings, as well as boxes, bags, folding tables or other materials for events May occasionally require late nights during select periods of high-intensity advocacy during the NYS Legislative session. All employees must be fully vaccinated for COVID-19. Riverkeeper is an AA/EEO employer. Riverkeeper is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional people, and to creating a work environment that is dynamic, rewarding, and enables each of us to realize our potential. Our work environment is safe and open to all employees and partners, respecting the full spectrum of race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, political affiliation, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and all other classifications protected by law. People from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Learn more here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: SVP, International Relations
item.description: SVP, International Relations Organization: U.S. Soccer Federation Location: Atlanta, GA Date Posted: 10/05/2026 U.S. Soccer Overview The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good. We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S. U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results. Position Description The SVP, International Relations will lead U.S. Soccer’s global engagement strategy, building and managing the relationships, influence, and operational infrastructure that advance U.S. Soccer’s In Service to Soccer Strategy within the international soccer ecosystem. This function is an enterprise-servicing role, engaging cross-functionally with U.S. Soccer leadership and external partners to help drive forward our 2032 Shared Goals. This role sits at the intersection of international strategy, protocol and operations, and ongoing relationship management, and is core to how U.S. Soccer positions itself within FIFA, Concacaf Primary Responsibilities Global Strategy & Influence: Serve as one of U.S. Soccer’s primary liaisons to FIFA, Concacaf, and other confederations and member associations, while developing and executing an influence and advocacy strategy advancing U.S. interests and position within global soccer. Federation Relations & Stakeholder Management: Build and steward relationships with key national federations and international stakeholders, driving concrete outcomes against our 2032 Shared Goals; support strategic execution across a number of workstreams with our core stakeholders in the global soccer world. Risk, Reputation & Stakeholder Diplomacy: Manage geopolitical, governance, and reputational risks facing U.S. Soccer internationally in support of the CEO/Secretary General and Federation President; support in crisis response involving international stakeholders; work hand-in-hand with U.S. Soccer’s Communications and Corporate/Government Affairs infrastructure to ensure alignment between international strategy and domestic policy, government relations, and corporate positioning. Protocol and Operations: Oversee the mechanics of international delegation hosting, executive engagements, and protocol at a standard befitting U.S. Soccer’s ambition, in alignment with U.S. Soccer’s sporting, fan, and commercial objectives. Liaise closely with Sporting to help deliver Coaching Education, Referee development and Player development pathways that can be shared with selected MA’s as part of the overall IR strategy. Liaise with Sporting on the Senior National Teams and Youth National Teams scheduling process to be fully aware of the Sporting and Commercial objectives. Competition, Hosting & Development: Lead international stakeholder strategy for major events; identify and pursue future hosting opportunities; partner with U.S. Soccer leadership team to develop overall commercial and advancement approach and execute on opportunities; including significant responsibilities of future Bid projects. Government Relations: Lead the relations with the U.S. State Department to support International Diplomacy initiatives, as needed. Serve as U.S. Soccer’s main contact for U.S. Embassies globally. Requirements Minimum Qualifications Multilingual — fluency in at least one language beyond English is critical (Spanish strongly preferred given Concacaf / CONMEBOL landscape). 15 + years of international / corporate affairs experience — prior work within international governing bodies, diplomacy, international government relations, or a top-tier sports federation. Demonstrated ability to build influence, navigate and drive outcomes across complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Standing and credibility to represent U.S. Soccer externally at the highest levels of global football governance. Understanding of global football dynamics (leagues, clubs, tournaments, international competitions). Strong communicator and negotiator with a track record of closing bilateral agreements and partnerships. High cultural fluency and comfort operating across diverse geographies and political contexts. Collaborative, enterprise-minded leader — this role succeeds by elevating the work of others across Legal/Corporate Affairs, Strategy, and the executive leadership team at U.S. Soccer. Proven capability to manage internal and external resources to accomplish goals. Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments. Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission. Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook). U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development. U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply. item.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Communications
item.description: Senior Manager, Corporate Communications Organization: U.S. Soccer Federation Location: Atlanta, GA Date Posted: 10/05/2026 U.S. Soccer Overview The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good. We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S. U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results. Position Description The Senior Manager, Corporate Communications supports and executes enterprise-wide communications strategies that build understanding, strengthen relationships, create meaningful opportunities for engagement and ensure U.S. Soccer’s Federation membership base feels informed, heard and connected to the organization’s mission and direction. In close partnership with the Senior Director of Corporate Communications and business partners across the Soccer Growth and Member Strategy teams, this role is responsible for developing and executing both internal and external communications plans and initiatives that reflect U.S. Soccer’s strategic priorities and mission. The ideal candidate is a strategic, proactive and relationship-driven communicator with experience navigating complex stakeholder environments and aligning messaging that helps members and key stakeholders including referees, coaches and youth leaders understand how the organizations work affects them. Areas of focus include executive communications, member engagement, and cross-functional coordination. This role oversees the development of executive briefing materials, talking points, background documents, and presentations for public appearances, media engagements, and internal leadership communications as it relates to Soccer Growth and Member Strategy initiatives. This role also supports larger Federation external functions, including board meetings, annual member meetings, annual general meetings of member organizations, regional meetings and public-facing appearances. Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration, the ability to synthesize complex information for diverse audiences, and a commitment to ensuring that U.S. Soccer’s internal communications infrastructure and external messaging are aligned and mission-driven. Primary Responsibilities Develop and execute corporate communications strategies that support organizational priorities and strengthen reputation among members, partners, media and other stakeholders. Develop executive communications, talking points, presentations, messages and other materials for internal and external audiences. Identify opportunities to proactively tell the organization’s story and demonstrate its impact. Build strong relationships across departments and serve as a communications thought partner to teams working directly with members and stakeholders. Collaborate with marketing, digital, events, executive leadership, advancement and other teams to create integrated engagement strategies. Develop and lead integrated communications strategies that strengthen member understanding, connection and engagement with the organization. Build communications plans around major organizational initiatives, changes, announcements and priorities. Play a lead role in building a monthly membership newsletter. Establish meaningful measures of communications and member engagement effectiveness. Requirements Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of experience in corporate communications, media relations, membership communications or a related field, ideally within sports, entertainment, or nonprofit sectors. Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. Strong understanding of the U.S. soccer ecosystem, including key stakeholders such as members, referees, coaches, and youth programs. Proven experience supporting C-suite executives with briefing materials, talking points, presentations, and internal/external messaging. Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communication skills across a variety of formats (speeches, memos, newsletters, social content, feature articles, etc.). Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive information and craft strategic responses in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations. Experience coordinating communications for high-profile events, such as board meetings, conventions, and internal town halls. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to develop clear, consistent messaging across internal and external channels, aligned with organizational mission and voice. Comfort working collaboratively across departments and building relationships at all levels of an organization. Experience communicating with a membership, association, nonprofit or similarly diverse stakeholder base strongly preferred. General knowledge of soccer. Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments. Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission. Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and travel up to two times per quarter. Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook). Desired Qualifications Strategic hustle, initiative, and work ethic with diversity of thought. Strong posture for empathy. Ability to build meaningful relationships both internally and externally. Able to think strategically and handle multiple projects. Confidence without ego. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Spanish language proficiency is a plus, but not required. U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development. U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply. item.title: Global Medical Affairs Associate – VIE Contract
item.description: Global Medical Affairs Associate – VIE Contract Organization: Sanofi Location: Cambridge, MA Date Posted: 10/05/2026 iMove, the Sanofi VIE Program, is available to citizens of the European Economic Area (EU + Norway, Liechtenstein and Iceland) aged between 18 and 28. PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship. PLEASE NOTE that applications that are only submitted in French cannot be considered by our non-French speaking partners at Sanofi worldwide. Therefore, only applications that are submitted in English will be considered. Please make sure to apply with your personal email address. About the job As Global Medical Affairs Associate VIE within our Therapeutic area team you will support a launch molecule in Hemophilia. You will gain exposure to medical strategy at different stages of the launch: (1) pre-launch including medical education and market shaping, (2) evolution of medical narratives based on evidence generation, and (3) strategic data dissemination based on clinical management needs. Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions. Ready to get started? About Sanofi We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main responsibilities: Support Global Medical Lead (GML) with implementation of the Global Medical Plan, with a key focus on project management and driving implementation of medical narrative across omnichannel initiatives. Partner with scientific communication team in the development and execution of the Global Publication Plan, with emphasis on manuscripts and congress presentations. Assist with trainings for country medical teams, including updating global tools/resources for launches into new markets. Support the development and evolution of Global Medical Affairs (GMA) strategy into 2028. Enhance and coordinate Key Opinion Leader (KOL) engagement strategy within GMA and with cross functional partners. Run monthly meetings for GMA and scientific communication& maintain project tracker. Assist with team projects and ad hoc initiatives based on needs. About you Experience: Experience supporting medical education, scientific writing and medical initiatives. Soft and technical skills: Ideally have worked in the field of orphan diseases; Hematology experience would be advantageous. Ability to plan/organize the work & tasks and to work within tight timelines. Strong sense of responsibility. Demonstrates positive attitude, proactive, embraces team spirit and comfortable with dynamic environment. Demonstrated relationship building at all levels of the organization and across geographies. Exhibits outstanding written and oral communication skills. Quick learner who can synthesize information and come up with creative solutions. Education: Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, Masters) preferred. Languages: Fluent English (verbal and written). Why choose us? Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development. Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes. Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams. Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective. Enjoy opportunities to collaborate beyond your area of expertise, working with diverse teams across science, clinical, and digital fields to spark new ideas and drive breakthroughs. Join a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core, with Employee Resource Groups and leadership programs that celebrate every voice. Achieve genuine work-life balance in a supportive R&D environment. iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow. Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. We provide those opportunities in various functions such as: marketing, finance, regulatory, supply chain, clinical trials, production, etc. and in more than 40 countries. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work. #LI-EUR Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary. Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science – where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what’s never-been-done-before. You’ll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people’s lives? Let’s Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together. At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. item.title: Senior Marketing Manager
item.description: Senior Marketing Manager Organization: Build Commonwealth Location: Boston MA Date Posted: 10/05/2026 Organization Overview Tens of millions of people in the U.S. live with chronic financial insecurity, inadequate savings, and no meaningful wealth, with deeply harmful consequences for themselves, their children, families, communities, employers, and the economy. Black, Latinx, and women-led households disproportionately experience financial insecurity due in large part to longstanding, systemic racism and gender discrimination. Addressing these issues is critical to Commonwealth’s work of making wealth possible for all. For over two decades, Commonwealth’s fundamental purpose has remained to create a stronger and more prosperous society where everyone has financial opportunity. Our work has enabled over 2 million people to save nearly $8 billion on a path to greater financial security and wealth. We are now embarking on a new four-year strategic plan that seeks greater impact and builds on our systems focus to expand workplace benefits, strengthen partnerships with financial institutions and fintech partners, and explore new frontiers like climate and generative AI. Commonwealth strengthens the financial opportunity and security of financially vulnerable people by discovering ideas, piloting solutions, and driving innovations to scale. We understand broad change requires market players to act. That is why we take a unique approach to collaborate with consumers, the financial services industry, employers, policymakers, and mission-driven organizations. The solutions we build are grounded in real life, based on our deep understanding of people who are financially vulnerable and how businesses can best serve them. For more than two decades, we have moved employers to prioritize worker financial security, the financial services industry to bring products to market that better serve financially vulnerable people, and policymakers to pass legislation and take action to enable savings and financial security. To learn more about the organization, please visit buildcommonwealth.org. Diversity of background and perspective are strengths that we value. We are committed to creating a diverse, dedicated, skilled, and collaborative environment, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Commonwealth recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected statuses. Position Overview Commonwealth is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager (SMM) to join our team. The role will be part of a passionate, highly cross-functional team dedicated to supporting Commonwealth’s mission of creating systemic change for people living with financial insecurity. This individual will work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director, Senior Vice Presidents, Project Owners, Project Managers, and other members of the marketing team. The SMM will serve as the marketing project lead for two or more projects and is responsible for ensuring the communications strategy and its implementation are aligned with and moving forward the overall goals of the project. Specific responsibilities include developing a marketing strategy to message and amplify specific project initiatives, creating a detailed marketing plan, and developing content such as project briefs, research reports, infographics, blog posts, and social media copy, in partnership and close collaboration with the project team(s). This individual will also work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director to ensure integration of owned content at an organizational and operational level, and to develop strategy around PR and events/conferences. The right person for this role has a roll-up-your-sleeves, get-the-work-done mentality. This is a great opportunity for someone who can think strategically, has extensive knowledge of marketing best practices, thrives in a collaborative team, and makes decisions based on data. A best fit is someone who thrives as much in strategy planning as they do in operational execution. The SMM will project manage the communications plan execution and production implementation, ensuring timely content publication and promotion. Please join us if you are looking to contribute to a fast-paced, social impact organization. Responsibilities Support the marketing strategy, development, management, and production for two or more Commonwealth programs, ensuring that marketing goals are met and remain top of mind throughout the life of the project. Create project-specific marketing strategy canvases and marketing plans, including communication of KPIs in partnership with the Project Owner; continuously update the plan with new information and ensure the project team is aligned with strategies. Project manage and execute all aspects of the marketing plan, including content development, amplification plans, deployment strategies, and post-mortem activities; lead production management for projects and assets. Act as marketing contact and liaison with external partners. Liaise with strategic marketing team members leading events, press opportunities, social media, and newsletters. Write marketing copy for social media posts, newsletters, blogs, and other digital marketing assets. Draft grant deliverable summaries and contribute to funder trackers and reporting. Support partner demonstrations through contribution to research methodologies, research participant recruiting efforts, development of partner communications campaign materials, and partner engagement as needed. Communicate and partner with the strategic marketing team on PR and speaking opportunities. Actively promote continuous learning and improvement, applying marketing best practices to every project. Creatively problem-solve and collaborate with a small, results-oriented team to keep projects on track toward both short-term milestones and long-term strategic objectives. Contribute to a positive organizational culture with high optimism, appetite for learning, and eagerness to collaborate with colleagues. Skills & Experience Exceptional project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects concurrently with a high degree of organization, attention to detail, and flexibility. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to coordinate multiple project deliverables with diverse stakeholders. Strong analytical, organizational, and prioritization skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to meet deadlines while working collaboratively with team members. Functions well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Brings a positive attitude, flexibility, and a solutions-oriented approach to challenging situations. Proven ability to leverage strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills to facilitate, negotiate, and influence complex issues and decisions. Strong skills in Google Drive (Sheets, Docs, and Slides), Asana or a similar project management tool, and HubSpot. Passionate about the mission of Commonwealth and driving social change through promoting financial security and opportunity for financially vulnerable people. Excited about marketing and communications as a tool for influence and achieving social impact goals. Experience in financial services, fintech, consulting, or another B2B environment with complex product offerings for business leaders is strongly preferred. Prior marketing or communications agency experience is strongly preferred. Prior D2C experience is valuable for work on partnership demonstrations and pilot programs. Compensation & Benefits Commonwealth offers a competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience and skills. Our staff are the key to our success. The starting annual salary range for this full-time position is $81,000-$90,000, and Commonwealth also offers a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: Medical insurance (premium-free for individual employees) Dental and vision insurance Short-term and long-term disability insurance available after one year of employment Life insurance Health Savings Account with employer contributions Retirement matching contributions (up to 2%) Generous paid vacation leave, sick leave, and 17 paid organizational holidays Summer Friday schedule every other week between June and Labor Day To Apply Apply online at: https://buildcommonwealth.bamboohr.com/careers/43?source=aWQ9MjU%3D This position is open immediately. Candidates will be reviewed on a rolling basis. No phone calls. Commonwealth provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Commonwealth complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. item.title: Director of Content Strategy
item.description: Director of Content Strategy Organization: Deep South Today Location: Remote Date Posted: 10/05/2026 Reports to: Executive Editor & Chief Content Officer Direct reports: Director, Deep South Today Studios Location: Flexible, regular travel to DST’s regional footprint is required if not based in the Deep South About Deep South Today Deep South Today is a nonprofit regional news network supporting member newsrooms — including Mississippi Today, Verite News, The Current, and the forthcoming Arkansas Today — committed to free, non-paywalled access, rigorous editorial ethics, and accountability journalism across the region. DST is in a period of rapid growth, expanding its editorial network and building new capabilities, including video journalism, live events, cross-newsroom collaboration, and a more connected approach to audience engagement. Position Summary DST is seeking a Director of Content Strategy to work in close partnership with the Executive Editor & Chief Content Officer on the network’s broader editorial roadmap and culture, and to lead four areas central to DST’s growth: Deep South Today Studios, an editorial-driven events strategy, and a repeatable model for multi-newsroom collaborative coverage. This is a senior editorial leadership role that will also include helping establish and execute network expansion strategy. Bigger picture goals like the content roadmap, organizational culture-building, and editorial expansion strategy are shared work with the Executive Editor, not responsibilities this role is expected to carry alone. This role would include direct management of the Director of Deep South Today Studios and overall ownership of DST Studios’ continued buildout. Key Responsibilities Strategic Partnership with the Executive Editor Work closely with the Executive Editor & Chief Content Officer to conceptualize and shape DST’s broader editorial roadmap and organizational culture as a thought partner and co-builder, not as the sole owner of these goals. Bring ideas, options, and a point of view to these bigger picture conversations, while final direction and ultimate accountability for the roadmap and culture remain with the Executive Editor. Translate the shared vision that comes out of this partnership into concrete execution across Studios, events, engagement, and cross-newsroom collaboration. Flag early where those bigger goals need the Executive Editor’s direct involvement, rather than assuming this role can or should carry them alone. Deep South Today Studios Directly manage the Director of Deep South Today Studios and take overall ownership of Studios’ continued buildout. Set editorial and operational direction for Studios, translating its strategic goals into a slate the Director executes against. Own Studios’ budget, staffing, and production standards in partnership with the Director. Track Studios’ editorial and audience output against its funded goals, and regularly report on progress to the Executive Editor. Editorial-Driven Events Strategy Manage DST’s network-wide strategy for turning original reporting into live events like panels, community convenings, and co-branded series. Communicate constantly with top newsroom editors to conceptualize in-person programming, and then work with various Deep South Today support staff to bring those ideas to life from concept, editorial framing, partner and funder coordination, logistics and follow-up. With the Executive Editor & Chief Content Officer’s direction, define success metrics for events (audience reach, editorial impact, funder relations) and report on them regularly. Partner with DST’s Audience & Engagement Director to shore up and support a strong digital strategy across social media, newsletters and other existing platforms. Drive and foster adoption of that digital strategy inside the newsrooms themselves, encouraging and overseeing implementation among top editors so it all becomes a reality inside each newsroom. Multi-Newsroom Collaboration Leadership Serve as the network’s point leader for coordinating major cross-newsroom coverage projects. Build a repeatable playbook — working-group structure, timelines, a shared editorial calendar — so DST can stand up a multi-newsroom collaboration program. Act as the central point of contact across newsrooms during breaking or fast-moving coordinated coverage moments. Convene regular cross-newsroom editorial touchpoints so collaboration becomes a standing practice rather than a one-off scramble. Qualifications 7+ years of journalism or media experience, including senior editorial leadership and experience managing multifaceted editorial projects; regional, local, or nonprofit newsroom experience strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience practicing radical transparency and constant communication across teams and with a variety of colleagues. Experience overseeing video/multimedia production teams or initiatives, ideally at the scale of a studio or video/audio unit. Experience building or running editorially-driven live events, ideally tied to reporting or funder partnerships. Strong fluency in digital audience strategy (social, newsletters) and demonstrated experience building in-person or community-based audience programming. A track record of securing buy-in and adoption for a strategy across independent teams, not just designing it. Demonstrated success leading collaborative projects across multiple teams or newsrooms, especially under time pressure. Excellent project management skills; comfortable building process and structure where little currently exists. How to Apply: We’re committed to building an inclusive newsroom that represents the people and communities we serve. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply for this position, including women, people of color, LGBTQ people and people who are differently abled. Please apply here. Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Event Marketing Specialist
item.description: Event Marketing Specialist Organization: Internet2 Location: Remote Date Posted: 10/05/2026 Event Marketing Specialist – Remote Internet2 is a non-profit, member-driven advanced research and education (R&E) technology organization. Founded in 1996, we provide high-performance infrastructure and integrated cloud solutions, a secure trust fabric, and collaborative forums that allow U.S. higher education and research institutions to drive the next generation of scientific and academic discovery. National High-Performance Infrastructure: Delivers a resilient, secure, and automated network built for the most advanced scientific applications with a reduced environmental footprint. Seamless Global Access: Provides secure Wi-Fi at over 44,000 locations and facilitates worldwide collaboration through connectivity with international R&E networks. Community-Powered Cloud Solutions: Streamlines access to major cloud providers through community-powered procurement, pre-negotiated terms, and customized R&E services. Advanced Identity & Security: Establishes trust frameworks and access management tools that protect institutional data while enabling seamless cross-border collaboration. Community-Driven Innovation: Convenes R&E peers to co-create custom infrastructure, solve shared challenges, and transcend institutional boundaries. Read our 2025 Annual Report and visit our website (www.internet2.edu) to learn more about us. Position Summary: Internet2 is seeking an Event Marketing Specialist to own the marketing strategy and execution for its two flagship events: the Global Summit and Technology Exchange, which draw anywhere between 450–650 attendees from institutions across the U.S. and internationally. Email is the primary channel for driving registrations to these events, and each event campaign involves 40+ targeted emails sent across a diverse, segmented audience of 18,000+ contacts. This role sits within a small, integrated marketing and communications team and works closely with peers in strategic communications, digital experience, and convening to deliver cohesive, high-impact event campaigns. In this role, you will craft tailored messaging that resonates across a wide range of reader profiles, from network engineers and IT architects to C-suite leaders, international participants, and first-time attendees. You will own the full email curriculum for both events: from strategy and content development through automation, A/B testing, and performance optimization. Beyond email, you will coordinate multi-channel promotion efforts spanning digital advertising, community amplification, social proof, and in-event engagement to maximize reach and registration conversion. Internet2 also supports additional community convening opportunities, and this role may be called upon to provide marketing support for those efforts as needed. Email Strategy & Content Own end-to-end email strategy and execution for Global Summit and Technology Exchange, managing 40+ emails per event across the full attendee lifecycle. Execute the event content strategy through targeted campaigns and automated journeys that engage prospective and returning attendees, nurture leads, support registration, and drive conversions. Write compelling, audience-focused copy and continuously optimize campaign performance through testing, analysis, and measurement of key engagement and growth metrics. Support list growth by identifying opportunities to capture new contacts through event landing pages, gated content, and registration pathways. Multi-Channel Event Promotion Coordinate event promotion across industry publications, digital channels, and owned platforms, ensuring timely execution and consistent messaging. Develop promotional assets, including attendee testimonials, case studies, speaker highlights, short-form videos, community spotlights, and event recaps. Align event marketing campaigns with broader organizational marketing and communications strategies to maximize reach and impact. Campaign Production Collaboration Serve as a member of the Strategic Communications team, partnering closely with Convening, Digital Experience, and other stakeholders to execute integrated event marketing campaigns. Partner with the Director of Community Events team to align email cadence and messaging with key event milestones, including calls for proposals, registration milestones, submission deadlines, program announcements, surveys, and post-event communications. Collaborate across Strategic Communications, Digital Marketing, Web Experience, Creative, Content Marketing, and Partnership Marketing teams to align messaging, campaign timing, audience targeting, and performance measurement. Coordinate with internal advocates, sponsors, and community partners to amplify key event milestones and campaign messages across email, professional networks, community channels, and owned platforms. Quality Assurance & Approvals Manage campaign review, approval, and quality assurance processes, ensuring communications are accurate, compliant, personalized, functional, and delivered on schedule. In-Event Marketing Experience Develop expertise in Internet2’s event mobile app platform and leverage in-app messaging, push notifications, and on-site engagement opportunities to enhance event marketing campaigns. The Ideal Candidate: Possesses exceptional writing skills and can adapt messaging to resonate with a wide range of audiences, from highly technical practitioners to senior executives, while leveraging data and insights to continuously optimize performance. Thrives in a fast-paced environment, balancing creativity with strong project management and attention to detail, and is comfortable owning complex, multi-touch campaigns from concept through execution and analysis. Energized by Internet2’s mission, enjoys working across cross-functional teams, and is motivated by connecting communities through impactful events and communications. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing (or related field); or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. 6+ years of experience in event or integrated marketing, with a strong focus on copywriting, audience segmentation, multi-channel campaign execution, and measurable engagement outcomes. Experience with Pardot or a similar marketing automation platform. Experience managing large email databases, developing audience segments, and executing high-volume campaigns across multiple audiences simultaneously. Proven ability to write clear, persuasive, audience-focused content that drives engagement and conversion. Experience coordinating integrated marketing campaigns across digital advertising, social media, and other channels. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable insights. Excellent organizational, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across teams. Ability to travel up to 10% per year within the United States to support Internet2 events and attend team planning meetings. Cover letter required, highlighting directly relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing persona-based content strategies and audience-focused messaging for diverse audiences, from technical practitioners to executives. Experience creating event marketing assets, including testimonials, case studies, peer endorsements, and short-form video content. Experience with Stripo or similar email design tools, plus familiarity with event apps, in-app messaging, and push notifications. Understanding of email marketing regulations, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CASL. Portfolio demonstrating successful event, conference, or multi-channel marketing campaigns. What We Offer: As a full-time employee, you will be eligible to participate in Internet2’s employee benefits program effective on your start date in accordance with the terms and conditions of each plan. The program currently includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances, a health spending account program, sick time, vacation time and a tax deferred retirement plan. Pay Grade: B-4 Expected Hiring Range: $63,200 – $71,100 Starting salary is commensurate and may vary with experience and education. For pay transparency purposes, the full salary range is: $63,200 – $94,800 Internet2 is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization and equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. item.title: Senior Counsel, Employment
item.description: Senior Counsel, Employment Organization: Public Storage Location: Frisco, TX Date Posted: 10/05/2026 About Public Storage Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities in the world. With thousands of locations across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we’re also one of the largest landlords. We’ve been recognized as A Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having Best Career Growth, ranked us in the Top 5% for Work Culture, and in the Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion. We’re a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange. Public Storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. We are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence. Description We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic legal professional to join our team as Senior Counsel, Employment. This role will be instrumental in providing comprehensive strategic legal advice to our Human Resources team and other business leaders wide range of employment related issues, including hiring and workplace practices, leave and accommodation matters, wage and hour compliance, and employee discipline. The ideal candidate will be a proactive legal partner able to navigate the complexities of our business environment with integrity and strategic acumen. Key Responsibilities Advice and Counseling: Provide day-to-day expert legal advice and counseling to management and human resources business partners on employment issues, including recruiting, hiring, employee relations, discipline, terminations, reductions-in-force, leaves of absence, accommodations, wage and hour compliance, and immigration. Advise on compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws (Title VII, ADA, ADEA, FMLA, FLSA, and equivalent state statutes). Dispute Management: Assist in the management of employment litigation and respond to pre-litigation demands and federal and state agency charges, including investigating employment law claims and responding to EEOC charges and state agency charges. External Counsel Management: Oversee and manage outside counsel to achieve optimal efficiencies, outcomes, and value for the company. Investigations: Lead and advise human resources and other internal partners on the investigation of employee complaints and anonymous reports, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate follow-up and reporting. Policy Formulation and Revision: Design, review and advise on employment policies, handbooks, offer letters, severance agreements, and restrictive covenants HR Collaboration: Partner with HR Business partners on the design of programs and tools to guide team members on various employment laws and best practices. Legal Developments Monitoring: Monitor and interpret employment law developments and provide relevant summary communications and recommendations to human resources and other business partners. Ad Hoc Projects: Work on ad hoc legal employment law-related projects, including offer letters, policies, templates, and processes. Representation: May represent the company in administrative proceedings. Qualification Education: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school Bar Admission: Must be an active member in good standing of the TX bar or other bar and eligible to practice in-house in TX. item.title: Director, State Legislative & Regulatory Affairs
item.description: Director, State Legislative & Regulatory Affairs Organization: Public Storage Location: Frisco, TX Date Posted: 10/05/2026 About Public Storage Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities in the world. With thousands of locations across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we’re also one of the largest landlords. We’ve been recognized as A Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute. And, our employees have also voted us as having Best Career Growth, ranked us in the Top 5% for Work Culture, and in the Top 10% for Diversity and Inclusion. We’re a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stocks trade on the New York Stock Exchange. Public Storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. We are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence. Description The Director, State Legislative & Regulatory Affairs will monitor, assess, and help shape state and local policy developments affecting Public Storage and the self-storage industry. This role will serve as a strategic advisor to Legal, Compliance, Operations, Revenue Management, Marketing, Risk, and senior leadership on legislative and regulatory issues, with particular emphasis on consumer protection, pricing, advertising and marketing, lien laws, insurance, property operations, taxation, privacy, and other matters affecting a nationwide consumer-facing real estate business. The successful candidate will bring deep experience monitoring and managing legislative and regulatory activity across multiple states, translating complex developments into practical business guidance, and leading coordinated efforts among internal stakeholders, outside counsel, consultants, contract lobbyists, trade associations, and cross-functional teams nationwide. A law degree is not required; Public Storage is seeking a seasoned public policy, state government affairs, or regulatory affairs leader who can build scalable processes and manage a national portfolio of issues with sound judgment and executive presence. Key Responsibilities Monitor, analyze, and report on state and local legislative and regulatory developments affecting Public Storage, including proposed legislation, administrative rulemaking, attorney general activity, agency guidance, and emerging policy trends. Develop and manage a nationwide issue-tracking process that identifies risks and opportunities across multiple states and escalates priority matters to Legal, Compliance, Operations, and senior business leaders. Lead the coordination of state advocacy strategies, including developing policy positions, drafting testimony and comment letters, recommending legislative language, and supporting direct engagement with policymakers and regulators. Manage and coordinate external resources, including contract lobbyists, outside counsel, consultants, trade associations, and coalition partners, to ensure consistent strategy, timely intelligence, and effective execution across jurisdictions. Partner with internal stakeholders to assess the operational, financial, compliance, customer, and reputational impact of proposed laws and regulations and recommend practical response strategies. Translate complex legislative and regulatory developments into clear, actionable guidance for executives and business teams. Support regulatory and legislative strategies related to consumer protection, pricing, advertising and marketing, lien laws, insurance and risk, property operations, tax, privacy, call center practices, and other issues affecting the self-storage industry. Build and maintain relationships with state legislators, regulators, agency staff, attorneys general offices, governors’ offices, trade associations, business coalitions, and other external stakeholders. Prepare briefings, memoranda, issue summaries, talking points, testimony, correspondence, and executive-level reports on key legislative and regulatory matters. Track lobbying, political, gift, ethics, and disclosure obligations in partnership with Legal and Compliance to support adherence to applicable federal, state, and local requirements. Support integration and compliance planning for business expansion, acquisitions, entry into new jurisdictions, and changes in state operating requirements. Manage cross-functional workstreams and nationwide teams to ensure alignment, accountability, and timely execution on priority legislative and regulatory matters. Qualification 10–12+ years of relevant experience in state government affairs, legislative affairs, regulatory affairs, public policy, trade association advocacy, or a related role. Demonstrated experience monitoring, analyzing, and managing legislative and regulatory developments across multiple states. Proven ability to manage nationwide teams, external consultants, contract lobbyists, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment. Strong understanding of state legislative and regulatory processes, including bill tracking, committee activity, rulemaking, public comment processes, coalition advocacy, and policymaker engagement. Experience developing advocacy strategies and translating policy developments into business, operational, and compliance recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft testimony, comment letters, policy briefs, executive summaries, and strategic recommendations. Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing issues, manage deadlines across jurisdictions, and create scalable systems for tracking and reporting. Sound judgment, discretion, and ability to advise senior leaders on sensitive, fast-moving, and high-impact public policy matters. Bachelor’s degree in political science, public policy, public administration, business, communications, or a related field required; advanced degree, public policy degree, or J.D. welcome but not required. Ability to travel regularly to state capitals, industry meetings, company locations, and external stakeholder engagements as needed. Preferred Experience Experience working for or with a national, multi-state, consumer-facing, real estate, retail, property management, financial services, logistics, or regulated services business. Experience managing issue portfolios involving consumer protection, pricing, advertising and marketing, contracts, lien laws, insurance, tax, privacy, or property operations. Familiarity with legislative tracking and government affairs platforms such as Quorum, FiscalNote, LexisNexis State Net, PolicyNote, or similar tools. Experience working with trade associations, coalitions, attorneys general offices, state regulatory agencies, and bipartisan policymaker networks. Experience building a legislative and regulatory affairs function, including processes for issue intake, tracking, escalation, stakeholder engagement, and executive reporting. Key Attributes Strategic, practical, and business-oriented approach to public policy and regulatory risk. Ability to operate independently while keeping internal stakeholders aligned and informed. Executive presence and credibility with senior leaders, policymakers, regulators, and external partners. Comfort managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and fast-moving legislative sessions across multiple jurisdictions. Collaborative style with the ability to lead through influence across legal, operational, compliance, and business teams. Additional Information Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. **Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.** REF4467F Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Director, Government Affairs, State, Local & Education (SLED)
item.description: Director, Government Affairs, State, Local & Education (SLED) Organization: Palo Alto Networks® Location: Washington, DC Date Posted: 10/07/2026 Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Summary The Director of Government Affairs (SLED) leads the company’s public policy and government affairs strategy across U.S. state, local, and education markets. This role serves as a strategic thought leader on key industry issues—specifically shaping policy around cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence (AI)—to enable public sector business growth and advocate for favorable policy environments. You will manage a roster of external consultants, leverage national trade associations, and build deep relationships with state and local officials to drive measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Policy Strategy & Advocacy: Shape, track, and influence state and local legislation and regulations impacting cybersecurity, AI, and digital resilience. Public Sector Business Enablement: Align government affairs efforts with sales and business development teams to navigate complex SLED procurement processes and unlock public sector opportunities. External Relationship Management: Cultivate strong networks with key state/local cyber and IT-focused officials, decision-makers, and policymakers. Trade & Association Leadership: Represent the company within relevant trade associations, coalitions, and national SLED organizations to amplify advocacy priorities. Consultant Management: Directly oversee and direct a dynamic network of outside government relations consultants and contract lobbyists across key jurisdictions. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal go-to-market, product, legal, compliance, and executive leadership teams to align public policy initiatives with corporate goals. Qualifications Required Qualifications Proven track record in state, local, and education government affairs, with deep knowledge of policy issues surrounding cybersecurity and AI. Established relationships with state and local CIOs, CISOs, legislators, and key IT procurement officials. Sound understanding of legislative budget cycles and public sector acquisition processes. Demonstrated success leveraging trade associations and national organizations (e.g., NASCIO, NGA) to advance policy goals. Exceptional written, verbal, and executive presentation abilities. Minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience in government affairs, public policy, or a related field with recent experience in a leadership role. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (e.g., JD, Master’s in Public Policy, or Public Administration). Experience working directly within a state or local government agency, particularly in a technology or cybersecurity capacity. Prior experience managing government relations consultants and contract lobbyists effectively. Compensation Disclosure The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here(opens in new window). $212,700.00 – $291,900.00/yr Our Commitment We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at [email protected] (opens in new window). Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position. Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.description: Content Trends, Associate Producer Organization: Snap Inc Location: Los Angeles, CA Date Posted: 10/07/2026 Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services. We’re looking for a Content Trends, Associate Producer to join our Content team at Snap Inc! What you’ll do: Play a key role in identifying timely, trending, culturally relevant public content and creators on Snapchat Collaborate with fellow Trend Curators and Producers to help Snapchatters stay connected with their local and global communities through fresh, exciting, and informative Snaps. Identify trends emerging creators, tentpoles moments and culturally relevant topics that our community cares about most on a daily basis while also being hyper reactive to new unexpected moments that arise during your shift Identify and work with emerging content creators Surface timely, trending and fresh publicly submitted content Work collaboratively with a group of Trend Curators tasked with searching through thousands of snaps to identify tentpole moments, trends, timely conversations and culturally relevant themes Review and moderate submitted Snaps in real time Engage in ongoing conversations with engineering, moderation, and product teams to communicate and resolve any issues that arise during your shift Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: An expert in US short from video trends, major pop culture moments and timely tentpole events Deep understanding of Gen Alpha, Gen Z and Millennials A highly motivated teammate who is hyper reactive, proactive and a skilled communicator Outstanding research and organizational skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a sharp attention to detail Strong editorial eye and understanding of what makes an engaging piece of content Someone up-to-date on pop culture, trends, and current events Teamplayer who is kind and respectful of other’s opinions Minimum Qualifications: BA or BS degree in relevant field 1+ years of experience working in digital media, social, or content driven environments (i.e. internet trends, pop culture and hyper timely moments) Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, as needed Preferred Qualifications: BA or BS degree in relevant field Preferred previous experience at Snap Someone who has a flexible schedule and the ability to work during nights and weekends, as needed Experience navigating multiple social platforms and demonstrated interest in short form content “Default Together” Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week. At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets. Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!
